top_signals.title: Gold Trims Gain as Fed Holds Rates, Signals Hike Support
top_signals.summary: Gold pared gains after the Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged as expected, while signaling that support for higher borrowing costs is growing as officials assess the inflationary impact of the Iran war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Crypto entering biggest consolidation phase in history, says ARK analyst
top_signals.summary: ARK Invest’s Lorenzo Valente says revenue is becoming increasingly concentrated among a handful of crypto protocols, setting the stage for more mergers, acquisitions and exchange closures.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
